subject: Org entry: access mission plan and onboarding runbook
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: David Price <david.price@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Org entry: access mission plan and onboarding runbook

Hi David —

Following our kickstart call last week, here’s a concise mission plan for getting Acme Retail’s first Redwood tenant live. Goal: admin invites + API key seeding + first project by next Thursday (11/19).

Top-level checklist (attached as a spreadsheet):
- Confirm admin list (SSO vs local accounts)
- Create tenant and default project namespace
- Seed two service API keys (one for staging, one for prod)
- Assign roles: 2x Admins, 1x Billing, 2x Devs
- Configure SSO (if requested) and verify SCIM user sync
- Upload SOW and coordinate signature for reserved capacity (optional)

Questions for you before we proceed:
1) Who should be the initial admin accounts (emails)?
2) Will Acme require SSO/SCIM or are local accounts ok for initial access?
3) Any compliance items (SOC2 evidence) needed before provisioning?

Next steps I propose:
- You reply with admin emails and SSO preference
- Ben (cc’d) will prepare the environment template and seed key plan
- We schedule a 30-minute provisioning call — I have availability Tue 11/16 10:00–12:00 ET or Wed 11/17 14:00–16:00 ET

Attachments referenced: redwood-tenant-access-checklist.xlsx (checklist), SOW-Acme-Redwood-v2.pdf (optional)

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0192

From: David Price <david.price@acmeretail.com>

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Org entry: access mission plan and onboarding runbook

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers:
- Initial admins: david.price@acmeretail.com, maria.gonzalez@acmeretail.com
- We prefer SSO + SCIM (Okta). Please share SCIM endpoint and attributes needed.
- We’ll need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short data retention summary before we seed prod keys; staging keys are fine to provision now.

We can do Tue 11/16 at 10:30 ET for the provisioning call — that works for our team.

-David
